user.title: Connect to VIVO Cloud
user.description: Open find.vivo.com.cn in a browser and sign in, then press F12 -> Network -> any request -> copy the full Cookie value into the field below. The Cookie must contain vivo_yun_csrftoken.

data.locate_on_update: Send a locate command on every refresh

data_description.device_name: Leave empty if the account has only one device. Otherwise use the device alias, e.g. iQOO
data_description.scan_interval: 300 seconds or more is recommended; polling too often may trigger VIVO rate limiting
data_description.locate_on_update: When on, the map shows the live position but uses more request quota. When off, only the cached position from the last fix is read
data_description.source_crs: VIVO returns GCJ-02 (Mars coordinates) in mainland China. Measured and confirmed - leave as is unless you have evidence otherwise.
data_description.target_crs: WGS84 is the Home Assistant standard: the default map card, zone and person tracking all use it. Choose GCJ-02 only if you render on AMap tiles yourself.

reauth_confirm.title: Update VIVO Cookie
reauth_confirm.description: The Cookie for "{name}" has expired. Sign in to find.vivo.com.cn again and paste the new full Cookie.

data.locate_on_update: Send a locate command on every refresh

error.auth: Cookie is invalid or expired. Get a new one (it must contain vivo_yun_csrftoken)
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach VIVO Cloud. Check your network and try again
error.no_device: No matching device found. Check the device name, or the account has no devices
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log for details

abort.reauth_failed: Re-authentication failed. Remove the integration and add it again
